D12.body:
【画风锚点】medium is a semi-realistic digital painting: glass, stone, fabric, foliage and sky are smoothly blended painted areas with no visible impasto and no dry-brush edges, and skin is clean and blended with no brush strokes on it; the picture still reads as a painting because of its soft hand-mixed transitions, its drawn edges and its idealized features, not because of thick paint; painted illustration rather than a snapshot; the Chinese sections below describe the subject, not the medium
【画面定位】位于东北外城环，中心(4.702,6.472)千米，面积22.1168平方公里，含科研、生活、道路和保留绿地。
【取景指令】建议在本片区外缘中轴公共观景屋面(5.937,8.171)千米，机位离地55米，35毫米朝216°拍摄。近景为遮阳板条影与浅灰砖屋面，中景为L034书岭联合实验楼、L035青岚仪器共享中心、L036科研伦理与公众交流馆与有边界院落，远景为内城城区与隐约湖面亮带。用7秒沿屋面缓慢横移，不从窗户进入实验空间，不展示非公开设备，录入步行、树叶与自行车声。255°夕光从右前侧斜入，蓝灰遮阳板与浅灰砖层次清楚；L007在画面左侧约14°远处，书岭山脊留在机位背后，不把山影搬到城区一侧。
【外观辨识】浅灰砖面配蓝灰遮阳板，固定板片在窗前形成稳定深浅节奏，水平连桥与竖向楼梯体相互区分。L034书岭联合实验楼6层、40米，L035青岚仪器共享中心4层、32米，体量厚实但分翼展开；L036科研伦理与公众交流馆10层、54米，以清晰公共入口区别实验楼。院墙留透空段而不暴露内部作业，铺地以灰石和细颗粒混凝土为主，香樟与朴树隔出坐谈阴影，夜景仅亮门厅及行走面。
【人群与烟火气】常住191000人并非全是高学历研究者，还包括技师、保洁、教师、零售人员与多代家庭。早晨校门接送和通勤同步，午间有人在院外散步，晚间共享餐厅有带孩子的职工。少量轮班不代表人人熬夜，周末公共交流活动与住宅午休并存。缓坡、停留座椅和安静等候点兼顾老人、轮椅使用者及临时带行李的访客。｜画面内人物密度缺省档：街道层连续人流、人行道上人距1—3米（俯瞰条不作人物计数，但必须能看出地面有人在走）。本条人群段与锁定段的具体描写优先于该缺省档，冲突时按详档，不为凑人数增删人物。
【锁定与禁则】锁定浅灰砖蓝灰板、受边界约束的安静内院、有限连桥、公共交流馆与实验楼分工。禁止直接湖岸、无边界实验展示或全区豪华人才公寓；图片无水印无凭空文字。
【全局硬设定】虚构城市钛湖城，2013年，当代现实技术；「顶级现代化」按2010年代前沿读：玻璃塔群、LED媒体立面、地下环道与综合管廊、城市轨道与枢纽换乘、光纤到楼、洁净实验室与数据中心、自助闸机、电动大巴、施工围挡与吊装作业；不得用飞行汽车、载人无人机、全息投影、机器人服务员、自动驾驶车队或赛博义体表达现代性，不是赛博朋克；城市定位：顶级现代化科技城市 × 保存完好的中国老城街巷 × 烟火气。同一画面里科技层与老城层必须有物理接触，天上现代、地上生活——高层与设备在画面上半，人流与生活痕迹在画面下半；只有玻璃幕墙或只有仿古街都算不合格；画风：半写实数字绘画，颜料一律铺成平滑过渡、不做厚涂堆叠与干笔边缘，皮肤不带笔触也不画毛孔，表面是画出来的，不是照片，也不是描边平涂的动画赛璐璐；画感由柔和过渡、勾形与轻微理想化的五官承担；人物保持真实比例与实际年龄特征；本地坐标：湖心(0,0)，x向东、y向北，单位千米；方位北0°顺时针；中心湖约6.4×4.2千米椭圆，四面环山；清岚河西北入湖，澜川东南外流；默认光照：晚秋，太阳方位255°、高度6°，能见度12至18千米；清晨、夜景、雨后、阴天须显式标注为变体；天际线分层：L066钛心金融主塔458米为全城第一，L007钛湖之脊368米（含针状天线）为第二；200米以上的塔楼在内湖环金融与枢纽片区成簇，逐栋参数以空间名录为准，提示词内不复数；成簇只是正典事实、不构成本条画面的授权，背景天际线只许画【取景指令】逐一点名的独立远景对象，未点名者一律不入画；本条正文里的「远景」二字常指主体自身的远处构件，不构成另画一片城市背景或超高层塔群的许可；非对称直线斜削冠与细针状天线的组合只属于L007，任何其它塔楼不得复制该冠部；L007与L066均为直线形体，不得扭转；机场只在S02山外，跑道东西向3.2千米；不得出现第二个机场；禁止：湖中高楼、海港、大型人工岛、飞行汽车、把L007的斜削冠与针状天线安到别的塔楼上；山体遮挡：外围村镇通常不能透山看到湖面或主城天际线；正文中的无水印禁则指第三方或模型生成的水印、台标、logo与签名；招牌、店招、灯箱与门牌必须存在，但字形须是不可读的模糊笔画，不得形成可拼读的汉字或拉丁词，也不得凭空造出可读标语；平台强制AIGC角标与XMP中的TC260元数据标识不属禁则，须原样保留，不得裁剪、遮盖或修补

English tail: semi-realistic digital painting, smoothly blended paint on glass, stone, fabric and foliage with no impasto texture and no dry-brush edges, clean blended skin, sky as a smooth blended gradient, warm late-autumn palette, illustrated cityscape rather than a snapshot, painted high-angle district overview with a readable sector edge, modern layer (a cluster of 200-metre-class towers, transit viaduct, cranes on super-tall construction) and old layer (historic low-rise roof texture, old lanes and a riverside market street kept intact) sharing one frame with a visible contact edge where the two layers meet; which layer reads near and which reads far follows the Chinese framing section above, so do not default the tower cluster to the far side of the water, 7:4 横幅, the sun is 39 degrees to the right of the camera axis and outside this frame's 31 degree half-angle, so keep the sun disc, the setting-sun glow and any lens flare out of the picture entirely; paint only the light direction, the lit surfaces and the shadows the canon section describes, the background skyline beyond the main subject may contain only the distant objects the Chinese framing section names one by one; the word 远景 inside the Chinese sections usually points at a part of the main subject itself and never licenses a second city, so do not add a distant downtown skyline, a supertall cluster or a tower crane that the framing section does not name; background towers are composed from this canon's own geometry (straight shafts, louver bands and the flat or stepped crowns the Chinese sections name); any far tower this line does not name a crown form for stays a plain mass with a flat or stepped top and no invented crown, antenna or aperture; do not trace a real city's skyline and do not borrow a real supertall's crown, twist or aperture; L007 钛湖之脊 (368 metres) sits 14 degrees to the left of this camera, inside the 31 degree half-angle, which makes it geometrically admissible here, but the Chinese framing section stays the only thing that can put it in the picture and only where that section names it does the far view paint it as a deep blue-grey straight shaft closed by an asymmetric straight-cut sloped crown whose high side carries a slender needle antenna (非对称直线斜削冠＋细针状天线), and this crown belongs to L007 alone; L066 钛心金融主塔 (458 metres) sits 16 degrees to the left of this camera, inside the 31 degree half-angle, which makes it geometrically admissible here, but the Chinese framing section stays the only thing that can put it in the picture and only where that section names it does the far view paint it as a straight shaft whose section has small cut corners at the four corners and whose roof carries no crown antenna at all (四角小切角轮廓、禁止加塔冠天线), painted material texture, everyday people doing everyday things, street life must read as physical traces, at least three of: hanging laundry, potted plants and rooftop planting, market crates mid-unload, steam off a street food stall, lit shop lampboxes, parked bicycles and scooters, elders playing chess on backed stools, parents collecting children, construction hoarding with a tower crane, rubbish collection point and truck, a dog on a lead, puddle reflections after rain, shop signboards, banners, lampboxes and door plates must exist along the street, drawn as blurred non-readable strokes; they must not spell legible characters or Latin words and must not invent a readable slogan, not a photograph, no photorealistic pore detail, no lens grain as the look, not a 3D render, no cel outline, no flat cel fills, not a cartoon, not an idol illustration; era 2013: no flying cars, no holograms, no humanoid robots, no cyberpunk, no near-future sci-fi, no autonomous vehicle fleets, no neon-drenched street replacing street life; no recognizable real-world skyline (Lujiazui, Hong Kong, Shenzhen Bay, Manhattan, Dubai, Chicago) and no crown, twist or aperture copied from a real supertall; nothing written on the ground or pavement in any corner; no letter-shaped signature cluster, monogram or floating glyph strokes on street surfaces, kerbs or in the four corners of the frame, no third-party or model-generated watermark, logo or signature, preserve mandatory platform AIGC labels and TC260 XMP metadata unchanged, no invented landmark, everything above in the Chinese canon sections overrides this line.

R120.body:
【画风锚点】medium is a semi-realistic digital painting: glass, stone, fabric, foliage and sky are smoothly blended painted areas with no visible impasto and no dry-brush edges, and skin is clean and blended with no brush strokes on it; the picture still reads as a painting because of its soft hand-mixed transitions, its drawn edges and its idealized features, not because of thick paint; painted illustration rather than a snapshot; the Chinese sections below describe the subject, not the medium
【画面定位】水尺巷位于主城西北偏北外缘，属D20北港水务片区，中心(-3.994,8.565)千米。
【取景指令】晚秋黄昏在南侧主街离地1.6米、40毫米镜头朝北，前景取素色石条矮墙和递书的手，中景是深绿栏杆、高窗阅读室和经过的家庭，远景为退后的楼梯间屋顶。连续9秒向东平移，先显出短巷再露出宽主街，不穿花园或进入窗内。255°光从左后侧进入，石条出现短而清晰的影，收录书页、脚步和树叶声，不额外加入清岚河水声。
【外观辨识】浅蓝灰混凝土墙面以窄竖凹槽配水平长窗，阳台深绿栏杆在每个开间保持统一顶线。平屋顶的楼梯间小屋错落退后，阅读室低坡顶下有连续高窗。步行街一段矮墙嵌入高低不同的素色石条，以水尺节奏形成抽象识别，不生成未经确认的数字刻度。地面用灰色矩形砖，阶梯花园中莎草和芦苇相间，香樟在主要路口留出视线。夜灯沿凹位照清石条纹理，不让整墙发亮。
【人群与烟火气】住户包含水务技术人员、零售职员、维修工、教师、医护、退休者和年轻家庭。清晨主街通勤速度较快，短巷里有人收晾衣物；下午阅读室接待学生与老人，夜间食堂给较晚归家者留正常便餐。周末居民在巷口小场地办书籍交换，水务并非唯一话题。活动自愿，不要求观察水位。轮椅、送餐车和婴儿车走宽主街，短巷家具不占通道。｜画面内人物密度缺省档：8—25人，含老人带孩、晾晒、遛狗、下棋、买菜归来；晾晒与盆栽不得堵通道。本条人群段与锁定段的具体描写优先于该缺省档，冲突时按详档，不为凑人数增删人物。
【锁定与禁则】固定素色石条矮墙、窄竖凹槽混凝土、统一顶线深绿栏杆和宽街短巷网络。禁止生成假水位数字、临河堤岸、湖景及全低层水乡巷弄，不超69米。图片无水印、无凭空文字。
【全局硬设定】虚构城市钛湖城，2013年，当代现实技术；「顶级现代化」按2010年代前沿读：玻璃塔群、LED媒体立面、地下环道与综合管廊、城市轨道与枢纽换乘、光纤到楼、洁净实验室与数据中心、自助闸机、电动大巴、施工围挡与吊装作业；不得用飞行汽车、载人无人机、全息投影、机器人服务员、自动驾驶车队或赛博义体表达现代性，不是赛博朋克；城市定位：顶级现代化科技城市 × 保存完好的中国老城街巷 × 烟火气。同一画面里科技层与老城层必须有物理接触，天上现代、地上生活——高层与设备在画面上半，人流与生活痕迹在画面下半；只有玻璃幕墙或只有仿古街都算不合格；画风：半写实数字绘画，颜料一律铺成平滑过渡、不做厚涂堆叠与干笔边缘，皮肤不带笔触也不画毛孔，表面是画出来的，不是照片，也不是描边平涂的动画赛璐璐；画感由柔和过渡、勾形与轻微理想化的五官承担；人物保持真实比例与实际年龄特征；本地坐标：湖心(0,0)，x向东、y向北，单位千米；方位北0°顺时针；中心湖约6.4×4.2千米椭圆，四面环山；清岚河西北入湖，澜川东南外流；默认光照：晚秋，太阳方位255°、高度6°，能见度12至18千米；清晨、夜景、雨后、阴天须显式标注为变体；天际线分层：L066钛心金融主塔458米为全城第一，L007钛湖之脊368米（含针状天线）为第二；200米以上的塔楼在内湖环金融与枢纽片区成簇，逐栋参数以空间名录为准，提示词内不复数；成簇只是正典事实、不构成本条画面的授权，背景天际线只许画【取景指令】逐一点名的独立远景对象，未点名者一律不入画；本条正文里的「远景」二字常指主体自身的远处构件，不构成另画一片城市背景或超高层塔群的许可；非对称直线斜削冠与细针状天线的组合只属于L007，任何其它塔楼不得复制该冠部；L007与L066均为直线形体，不得扭转；机场只在S02山外，跑道东西向3.2千米；不得出现第二个机场；禁止：湖中高楼、海港、大型人工岛、飞行汽车、把L007的斜削冠与针状天线安到别的塔楼上；山体遮挡：外围村镇通常不能透山看到湖面或主城天际线；正文中的无水印禁则指第三方或模型生成的水印、台标、logo与签名；招牌、店招、灯箱与门牌必须存在，但字形须是不可读的模糊笔画，不得形成可拼读的汉字或拉丁词，也不得凭空造出可读标语；平台强制AIGC角标与XMP中的TC260元数据标识不属禁则，须原样保留，不得裁剪、遮盖或修补

L037.body:
【画风锚点】medium is a semi-realistic digital painting: glass, stone, fabric, foliage and sky are smoothly blended painted areas with no visible impasto and no dry-brush edges, and skin is clean and blended with no brush strokes on it; the picture still reads as a painting because of its soft hand-mixed transitions, its drawn edges and its idealized features, not because of thick paint; painted illustration rather than a snapshot; the Chinese sections below describe the subject, not the medium
【画面定位】钛湖东站位于湖心东北偏东的外城D13东门枢纽片区，中心(6.21,3.442)千米。
【取景指令】在西南站前公共步行场离地1.6米，朝东北，以24毫米拍长屋盖。前景取盲道与拉杆箱，中景为家人会合，远景是透明侧厅与连续柱列。连续8秒沿步行场缓移两米，避开盲道和排队口，不穿检票边界，不使用无人机进入铁路空间。255°夕光从左后侧擦亮金属缝，收录轮声及不可辨读的远处广播，不以湖面作背景。
【外观辨识】浅钛金属长屋盖是主要轮廓，平行屋脊略有起伏，分缝沿长向延伸，不画成机场机翼雕塑。端部透明侧厅由细密灰色竖梃支撑，玻璃反射克制，能辨出内部人流而非通透到铁路设备。屋盖深挑到入口柱列，柱脚以深灰石收边。广场采用浅灰大板与连续盲道，乔木集中在步行场边而不遮住门口。夜间侧厅发出均匀暖白光，站台照明隐藏在屋盖之下，无彩色追光屋顶。
【人群与烟火气】清晨有跨城通勤者、站务、保洁和餐饮人员，行李箱轮声沿檐下回响。白天混合商务旅客、探亲家庭、学生与陪同行动不便者，检票工作人员维持队列，不把每处空地塞满人群。傍晚集中到达时，接站者在明确的公共等候区停留；末班前后人流渐疏，夜间仍有必要值守与养护，不能以长曝光表现永不停止的满负荷客流。｜画面内人物密度缺省档：前景与中景合计15—40人，主体人物组3—6人，至少一组正在做具体的事（搬、聊、等、吃）。本条人群段与锁定段的具体描写优先于该缺省档，冲突时按详档，不为凑人数增删人物。
【锁定与禁则】锁定0.31平方公里、198000平方米、3层39米、浅钛长屋盖和透明侧厅。禁止增建机场、穿湖铁路、超高站塔或悬浮列车。所有图像无水印、无凭空文字，运行区不作为拍摄路径。
【全局硬设定】虚构城市钛湖城，2013年，当代现实技术；「顶级现代化」按2010年代前沿读：玻璃塔群、LED媒体立面、地下环道与综合管廊、城市轨道与枢纽换乘、光纤到楼、洁净实验室与数据中心、自助闸机、电动大巴、施工围挡与吊装作业；不得用飞行汽车、载人无人机、全息投影、机器人服务员、自动驾驶车队或赛博义体表达现代性，不是赛博朋克；城市定位：顶级现代化科技城市 × 保存完好的中国老城街巷 × 烟火气。同一画面里科技层与老城层必须有物理接触，天上现代、地上生活——高层与设备在画面上半，人流与生活痕迹在画面下半；只有玻璃幕墙或只有仿古街都算不合格；画风：半写实数字绘画，颜料一律铺成平滑过渡、不做厚涂堆叠与干笔边缘，皮肤不带笔触也不画毛孔，表面是画出来的，不是照片，也不是描边平涂的动画赛璐璐；画感由柔和过渡、勾形与轻微理想化的五官承担；人物保持真实比例与实际年龄特征；本地坐标：湖心(0,0)，x向东、y向北，单位千米；方位北0°顺时针；中心湖约6.4×4.2千米椭圆，四面环山；清岚河西北入湖，澜川东南外流；默认光照：晚秋，太阳方位255°、高度6°，能见度12至18千米；清晨、夜景、雨后、阴天须显式标注为变体；天际线分层：L066钛心金融主塔458米为全城第一，L007钛湖之脊368米（含针状天线）为第二；200米以上的塔楼在内湖环金融与枢纽片区成簇，逐栋参数以空间名录为准，提示词内不复数；成簇只是正典事实、不构成本条画面的授权，背景天际线只许画【取景指令】逐一点名的独立远景对象，未点名者一律不入画；本条正文里的「远景」二字常指主体自身的远处构件，不构成另画一片城市背景或超高层塔群的许可；非对称直线斜削冠与细针状天线的组合只属于L007，任何其它塔楼不得复制该冠部；L007与L066均为直线形体，不得扭转；机场只在S02山外，跑道东西向3.2千米；不得出现第二个机场；禁止：湖中高楼、海港、大型人工岛、飞行汽车、把L007的斜削冠与针状天线安到别的塔楼上；山体遮挡：外围村镇通常不能透山看到湖面或主城天际线；正文中的无水印禁则指第三方或模型生成的水印、台标、logo与签名；招牌、店招、灯箱与门牌必须存在，但字形须是不可读的模糊笔画，不得形成可拼读的汉字或拉丁词，也不得凭空造出可读标语；平台强制AIGC角标与XMP中的TC260元数据标识不属禁则，须原样保留，不得裁剪、遮盖或修补

English tail: semi-realistic digital painting, smoothly blended paint on glass, stone, fabric and foliage with no impasto texture and no dry-brush edges, clean blended skin, sky as a smooth blended gradient, warm late-autumn palette, illustrated cityscape rather than a snapshot, painted landmark tower true to the canon section, modern layer (curtain-wall grid, lit sky-lobby bands, rooftop telecom and HVAC plant, LED media panel on the podium) rising out of old layer (grey-tile roofs, timber eaves, stone steps and a narrow old street touching the tower base), 3:2 横幅, the sun is 150 degrees to the left of the camera axis and outside this frame's 37 degree half-angle, so keep the sun disc, the setting-sun glow and any lens flare out of the picture entirely; paint only the light direction, the lit surfaces and the shadows the canon section describes, the background skyline beyond the main subject may contain only the distant objects the Chinese framing section names one by one; the word 远景 inside the Chinese sections usually points at a part of the main subject itself and never licenses a second city, so do not add a distant downtown skyline, a supertall cluster or a tower crane that the framing section does not name; background towers are composed from this canon's own geometry (straight shafts, louver bands and the flat or stepped crowns the Chinese sections name); any far tower this line does not name a crown form for stays a plain mass with a flat or stepped top and no invented crown, antenna or aperture; do not trace a real city's skyline and do not borrow a real supertall's crown, twist or aperture; L007 钛湖之脊 may appear only if the Chinese framing section names it, and then painted as a deep blue-grey straight shaft closed by an asymmetric straight-cut sloped crown whose high side carries a slender needle antenna (非对称直线斜削冠＋细针状天线), and this crown belongs to L007 alone; its crown must not be reused on any other tower; L066 钛心金融主塔 may appear only if the Chinese framing section names it, and then painted as a straight shaft whose section has small cut corners at the four corners and whose roof carries no crown antenna at all (四角小切角轮廓、禁止加塔冠天线); its crown must not be reused on any other tower, painted material texture, everyday people doing everyday things, street life must read as physical traces, at least three of: hanging laundry, potted plants and rooftop planting, market crates mid-unload, steam off a street food stall, lit shop lampboxes, parked bicycles and scooters, elders playing chess on backed stools, parents collecting children, construction hoarding with a tower crane, rubbish collection point and truck, a dog on a lead, puddle reflections after rain, shop signboards, banners, lampboxes and door plates must exist along the street, drawn as blurred non-readable strokes; they must not spell legible characters or Latin words and must not invent a readable slogan, not a photograph, no photorealistic pore detail, no lens grain as the look, not a 3D render, no cel outline, no flat cel fills, not a cartoon, not an idol illustration; era 2013: no flying cars, no holograms, no humanoid robots, no cyberpunk, no near-future sci-fi, no autonomous vehicle fleets, no neon-drenched street replacing street life; no recognizable real-world skyline (Lujiazui, Hong Kong, Shenzhen Bay, Manhattan, Dubai, Chicago) and no crown, twist or aperture copied from a real supertall; nothing written on the ground or pavement in any corner; no letter-shaped signature cluster, monogram or floating glyph strokes on street surfaces, kerbs or in the four corners of the frame, no third-party or model-generated watermark, logo or signature, preserve mandatory platform AIGC labels and TC260 XMP metadata unchanged, no invented landmark, everything above in the Chinese canon sections overrides this line.
